description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryService class in the OrangeHRM system, which depends on an external DAO class to manage employee directory data. It provides a method to get an instance of EmployeeDirectoryDao, creating it if necessary.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryService
classes.description: A service class providing access to Employee Directory data, lazy-initializing the EmployeeDirectoryDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeDirectoryDao instance, creating it if it hasn't been initialized yet.
